data.gender_notes: Marjina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Marjina is derived from the Arabic word 'marjana' which means 'to be soft, gentle, tender, or delicate'. It is a beautiful name with a rich Arabic origin and a soothing sound. The name Marjina carries the meaning “Gentle, tender, delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marjina usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
